# 1 Enoch Chapter 55 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**55:1** And-after this I-saw another host of-chariots of-men, and-they were-riding upon the-wind, and-they-came from-the-east, and-their-going was from-the-west.

**55:2** And-I-heard the-voice of-those-chariots, and-the-sound of-their-tumult, and-they-were numerous, and-they-came like-a-flood into-the-valley.

**55:3** And-I-saw in-that-day how a-great trembling seized the-heaven, and-the-host of-the-Most-High and-the-angels, a-thousand-thousands and-ten-thousand-times-ten-thousand, were-troubled with-great-trouble.

**55:4** And-the-Head-of-Days sat-upon His-throne of-glory, and-the-angels and-the-righteous-ones stood around-Him.

**55:5** And-a-great-trembling seized-me and-fear laid-hold of-me, and-my-loins gave-way, and-my-spirit was-dissolved, and-I-fell upon my-face.

**55:6** And-Michael sent another-angel from-among the-holy-ones and-he-raised me-up, and-when-he-had-raised me-up, my-spirit returned, for-I-had-not been-able to-endure the-look of-this-host, and-the-commotion and-the-quaking of-heaven.

**55:7** And-Michael said unto-me: Wherefore art-thou disquieted with-such a-vision? Until-this-day lasted the-day of-His-mercy; and-He-hath-been merciful and-long-suffering toward-those who-dwell on-the-earth.

**55:8** And-when-the-day, and-the-power, and-the-punishment, and-the-judgment come, which-the-Lord-of-Spirits hath-prepared for-those who-bow-not before the-righteous-law, and-for-those who-deny the-righteous-judgment, and-for-those who-take His-name in-vain — that-day is-prepared, for-the-elect a-covenant, but-for-sinners an-inquisition.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Bracketed words \[thus\] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text. Ch. 55 concludes the section on final judgment with a vision of the heavenly host; the day of mercy contrasted with the coming day of punishment.*
